metaDescription: UPL Sp 5 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: UPL Sp 5 is a registered sweet potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1985. Its record notes 13.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Yield:** 13.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** anywhere in the country, in the dry season.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Sp 5 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 13.4 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant UPL Sp 5 sweet potato

The registry recommends it for anywhere in the country in the dry season. Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.
